units.name: prepare
units.summary: Install rules and the project note; see if setup is due

units.name: list_components
units.summary: List the component folders to read

units.name: read_component
units.summary: Read one component folder; report findings

sizing.why: It reads one folder's code and tests and writes nothing; the writing session confirms each claim

judge_sizing.why: It reads one findings line against one folder, and the writing step's own check comes later

units.name: setup
units.summary: Write the overview spec and one spec per component

sizing.why: It reads a whole repository once and writes the specs every later task trusts

judge_sizing.why: It compares each written spec with the code it describes, one file at a time

units.name: triage
units.summary: Read the task, find the gaps, pick the route

sizing.why: It reads one task and the spec index to sort gaps and pick a route; the check verifies the note's shape

judge_sizing.why: It reads one note against the task; the route it confirms is cheap to correct later

units.name: discovery_short
units.summary: Confirm the cited behaviours; write the hand-off

sizing.why: It confirms that each behaviour triage cited answers its gap and lists the files the plan will need; it designs nothing, and the check verifies the cited ids

judge_sizing.why: A gap wrongly taken as answered costs a whole code session, so the verdict keeps the effort of the full visit's judge

units.name: owner_questions
units.summary: List the owner's questions of the one pause

units.name: read_gap
units.summary: Read one gap's documents and code; report findings

sizing.why: It reads one gap's documents and code and writes nothing; the writing session confirms each claim

judge_sizing.why: It reads one findings line against one gap row, and the check of the writing step comes later

units.name: discovery
units.summary: Close each gap with a spec, record or research note

sizing.why: It closes gaps by research and design, the deepest thinking in the workflow, and nothing downstream rechecks its facts

judge_sizing.why: It decides whether each gap is really closed across specs, records and research notes

units.name: plan
units.summary: Design requirements and phases; state complexity

sizing.why: It designs across specs and code, and a weak plan costs a whole code session

judge_sizing.why: It judges that the design covers every criterion and contradicts no spec it references

units.name: code_mode
units.summary: Pick one session or the expand step by the plan's size

units.name: expand
units.summary: Write task rows and verification for a complex plan

sizing.why: It turns an approved plan into task rows and decides little

judge_sizing.why: It compares the task rows with the plan they expand

units.name: phase
units.summary: Build one phase of the plan, tests first, and commit it

sizing.why: One phase of rows with the tests named; the check reads the rows and the judge the change

judge_sizing.why: It reads the rows of one phase against the files they name, and the check has read the marks

units.name: code
units.summary: Build the plan test first in one session

sizing.why: It is a long session that builds test first; the tests and the code check catch slips that more effort would not

judge_sizing.why: It reads the diff, the report and the proof of every criterion, and a miss ships a defect

units.name: independent_review
units.summary: Read the change as an independent reader; write findings

sizing.why: It reads a whole change with no account of how it was built and must find what the build's own gates missed; a missed defect ships

judge_sizing.why: It reads one findings document against the check's finding and lists the blocking findings; the reader's judgement is not redone
